visual.name: bfusionFinancialSCurve
visual.description: Cumulative S-Curve (Budget vs Actuals vs Forecast) with variance shading, projection cone, on-chart decision callouts and a collapsible decision-insight panel (EAC, variance at completion, required burn) for project financial management.

dataRoles.name: period
dataRoles.description: Time axis — supports Year > Quarter > Month > Week drill hierarchy.

dataRoles.name: budget
dataRoles.description: Periodic budget amount (e.g. Budget Cost). Required.

dataRoles.name: actuals
dataRoles.description: Periodic actual cost (e.g. Actual Cost). Required.

dataRoles.name: forecast
dataRoles.description: Periodic forecast cost over the full horizon (optional). Shown as dashed cumulative line; its total is used as EAC on the Auto method.

dataRoles.name: initialBudget
dataRoles.description: Periodic initial/baseline budget (optional). Shown as dotted baseline.

dataRoles.name: committed
dataRoles.description: Periodic committed spend (optional). Shown as cumulative area.

dataRoles.name: periodDate
dataRoles.description: Bind a measure returning the first date of each period, e.g. Period Start = MIN(Calendar[Date]). Enables the Status Date cut-off.

dataRoles.name: licenseToken
dataRoles.description: Bind to the single-cell BFusionLicense[Key] column in your model

mode.description: Surface theme for the visual chrome. Auto follows the report theme's background.

background.description: Custom mode only. Plot and root background.

surface.description: Custom mode only. Header, toolbar, insight panel, tiles and tooltips.

textColor.description: Custom mode only. Primary text colour.

mutedColor.description: Custom mode only. Labels, captions and axis text.

ruleColor.description: Custom mode only. Separators, tile borders and axis lines.

valueScale.description: Divide values by this factor for display.

showProjection.description: Extend actuals trend into future periods with confidence band.

statusDate.description: Reporting cut-off. Periods starting on or before this date count as elapsed. Requires the Period Start Date field to be bound.

showStatusDatePicker.description: Show a date picker on the visual so report viewers can set the cut-off without the Format pane.

tolerancePct.description: Deviation from plan still treated as on plan. Drives the status verdict, decision points and callouts.

eacMethod.description: How the estimate at completion is derived.

licenseKey.description: Paste your BFusion license key here. Contact info@bfusion.eu for a license.
